order: altitude, latitude (south to north), longitude (west to east)
notes: Trapped protons only, solar-minimum model. Solar-maximum fluxes at low altitude are lower.
B and L from a 2025 field so the SAA sits where it is today; AP8 itself is a 1960s model, so flux magnitudes with a modern field are an approximation.
AP8 gives no flux beyond its B/B0 cutoff, so the SAA edge is a cliff, not a gradual fall-off. The 1 degree grid sets how finely that edge is drawn.
Grid steps and the byte encoding are display choices.
